claims: Continue CRRT (Prismasate B32 K2, blood flow 200 mL/min, replacement 2000 mL/hr, dialysate 600 mL/hr) with hourly reassessment of ultrafiltration and circuit pressures.
Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and titrate FiO2/PEEP to maintain oxygenation, reassessing ABG after changes.
Continue norepinephrine infusion and titrate to maintain MAP goal, with frequent hemodynamic monitoring.
Transfuse packed red blood cells for severe anemia (Hgb 6.3-6.5 g/dL) with post-transfusion hemoglobin and vitals monitoring.
Obtain repeat arterial blood gas to reassess severe metabolic acidosis (pH 7.16-7.23, lactate 9-12.8, bicarbonate 9-12) and guide further therapy.
Recheck coagulation panel (INR 2.4-2.7, PTT 46-54 s, fibrinogen 97-163 mg/dL) and platelets (50-112 K/uL) given bleeding risk on CRRT.
Monitor serum potassium (3.8-4.3 mEq/L), ionized calcium (1.04-1.09 mmol/L), magnesium (1.7-2.0 mg/dL), and phosphate (6.8-7.6 mg/dL) with CRRT and replace electrolytes as needed.
Continue broad-spectrum antimicrobials (cefepime, aztreonam, vancomycin) and obtain repeat blood cultures to assess response.
Perform daily sedation interruption/lightening trial targeting RASS -1 to assess neurologic status while intubated.
Maintain VTE prophylaxis and pressure injury prevention with repositioning and skin care for bedbound, Braden-impaired patient.
